comment.narrative: Value is reported ex ante as required by methodology of EURF 2.10 indicator. However the current value is 180 MW. Indeed The Implementation Report No. 5 of the intervention covering period up to 31 December 2020 under Section f on page 6 states The construction works of the Mideit wind park have been finalized in December 2020 with an installed capacity of 180 MW. Operational results for the first months of operation are currently analyzed and will be communicated in the next report covering the reporting period 2021. For Jbel Lahdid the full installed capacity is expected to be achieved in 2024.

comment.narrative: Value is reported ex ante as required by methodology of EURF 2.10 indicator. However the current value is 180 MW. Indeed The Implementation Report No. 5 of the intervention covering period up to 31 December 2020 under Section f on page 6 states The construction works of the Mideit wind park have been finalized in December 2020 with an installed capacity of 180 MW. Operational results for the first months of operation are currently analyzed and will be communicated in the next report covering the reporting period 2021. For Jbel Lahdid the full installed capacity is expected to be achieved in 2024.
